notes: GAAP. Governmental receipts/disbursements/fund balances from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances (p5) Total Governmental Funds column; beginning_cash not shown. ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents on governmental funds Balance Sheet (p4) total column 2,665,277; CDs 1,073,103 (ending_investments) and county treasurer cash 48,688 are separate lines. Transfers: statement prints one net 'Transfers from (to) other funds' (294,705) outflow; per-fund amounts Sales Tax (16,597), Debt Service (328,108), Capital Projects +50,000 (p5); transfers_in 50,000, transfers_out 344,705 computed. Cross-check: matches Sewer fund Transfers from other funds 294,705 (p7), recorded in business_type.transfers_net. Business-type from Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position (p7) total column; no printed grand total of expenses, so total expenses = operating 924,618 + interest 7,531. Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) Total column; Construction in progress is zero and omitted; 'Unavailable revenue' printed under liabilities. Detail: General Fund combining schedule of departments (pp14-17; Administrative, Police, Municipal Building, Street Lighting on p14; Grants through Equipment on p15; Activity & Education through Park on p16; Pool through Senior and Total on p17). Revenue lines use the Total column (p17; all revenue is in Administrative/Rescue/Fire/Pool/Library etc. columns but only the total is recorded). Expenditures are recorded one line per department column per object line (zero cells omitted), 12 object lines summing to total expenditures 2,049,253 (p17); each department's lines tie to its printed Total expenditures. Category = the department's function: Administrative and Municipal Building, Employee Insurance, Equipment = general government; Police, Rescue, Fire Maintenance = public safety; Street Lighting, Tree Dump = streets/highways; Park, Park & Recreation, Pool, Library, Activity & Education, Youth Rec Center, Auditorium = culture/recreation; Cemetery, Senior = health/welfare; Grants and the Administrative 'Economic and community development' line = economic development; Capital outlay lines (Administrative 28,523, Rescue 31,406, Equipment 4,554, Pool 15,385, Cemetery 5,250 = 85,118) = capital outlay as on p5. Function totals do not tie to the p5 governmental-funds function columns (e.g. public safety here 306,993 vs p5 275,587; general government on p5 is 542,883), because the p5 functions are across all funds and classify departments differently; department function assignments for Grants, Tree Dump, Equipment, Activity & Education, Auditorium are judgment calls marked review. No budget_final printed on this schedule. This schedule supersedes the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule on p9 (not recorded; its actuals differ slightly from the statement). Street, Sales Tax, Debt Service, Capital Projects budget schedules (pp10-13) recorded; their actuals differ somewhat from the fund statement (e.g. Street sales tax 133,280 vs 139,763; Street spending 471,451 vs 466,806) so they do not tie to it. No schedules in trimmed PDF for Water/Sewer or Keno funds. Read pages 1-17 of 17
